free_tier_limits: Free access with EasyPost Wallet Carriers for up to 3,000 labels (postage excluded); after that, per-label fees apply. Bring Your Own Carrier Account (BYOCA) is $20/month plus applicable per-label fees; enterprise pricing is custom.
paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go with per-label fees after free tier; BYOCA $20/month + per-label fees; higher/enterprise tiers custom. Carrier postage and label fees vary by carrier and volume.
rate_limits: Index endpoints limited to 5 requests/second; other endpoint or carrier-specific limits may apply. Handle HTTP 429 with retry/backoff.
